subject: Request: short-term persistence snapshot for live-triage
messages:
From: Sara Lee <sara@cartographylabs.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term persistence snapshot for live-triage

Hi Mateo,

We started seeing an intermittent decoding error in our production calls to the /generate endpoint around 02:30 UTC this morning. The issue is time-sensitive because the repro only happens when a particular prefix is cached, and our environment's default retention window (24h) may expire the traces before engineering can reproduce it.

Can Redwood temporarily retain the request/response traces and KV cache slice for our tenant for a short window (48-72 hours) so our engineers can capture the repro locally? We only need this data scoped to the tenant_id: carto-prod-12 and the following trace ids: (attached trace_ids.txt). I've attached one representative screenshot of the error.

What we need from your side:
- A short carve-out to prevent automatic deletion for up to 72 hours
- Confirmation that access will be limited to redwood support engineers and that audit logs will be kept

We understand the sensitivity and prefer the smallest possible retention window that allows us to reproduce. Please advise next steps and any approvals you need.

Thanks,
Sara Lee
SRE, Cartography Labs
ops+triage@cartographylabs.com

Attachments: trace_ids.txt (text), screenshot.png (image)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lee <sara@cartographylabs.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term persistence snapshot for live-triage

Thanks for the heads-up, Sara — copying CS and Security so we can move this through the minimal-privilege approval path.

Quick plan:
- Proposed retention carve-out: 48 hours from approval (we can extend to 72 only with explicit justification).
- Scope: only request/response traces and the KV cache slice associated with tenant_id carto-prod-12 and the trace ids you listed. No broader dataset retention.
- Access: limited to redwood support engineers on call + one Cartography engineer (ops+triage). All access will be logged and retained for audit.

Actions I need from you:
1) Confirm the exact tenant_id (reply if carto-prod-12 is correct).
2) Confirm acceptance of a 48-hour window (we prefer this for policy reasons).
3) If you need 72 hours, explain why 48 is insufficient (we'll need to route to leadership).

Prioym / Monica: can you confirm compliance requirements and provide approval or escalation instructions? If OK, I will create the SUP ticket and configure the retention exception with the documented audit controls. I'll attach the internal SUP id in the follow-up.

- Mateo
Senior Support Engineer | Redwood Inference

Looping in compliance details. Thanks for early scoped plan, Mateo. A few controls we require before granting any retention carve-out:

1) Narrowest possible data scope: confirm the tenant_id and exact trace ids (we should only preserve those rows).
2) Timebox: we default to 48 hours. We allow 72 only with a written engineering justification (e.g., repro requires multiple customer cycles).
3) Attestation: Cartography needs to sign a short access attestation (we'll use DocuSign) acknowledging only specified engineers will access the data and they will export nothing beyond what's needed for debugging.
4) Audit and deletion confirmation: Redwood must enable an audit snapshot for the access window and confirm deletion at the end of the window; we'll send a deletion confirmation to the tenant contact and CS.

If the customer agrees to these conditions I am comfortable approving a 48-hour window. I'll open SUP-4123 and attach the attestation template.

DocuSign draft: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/signing/EXAMPLE-ATTEST-123
SUP ticket (to follow): https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4123

- Priyom
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference

Approved (48 hours) with the following conditions:
- Scope limited to tenant_id carto-prod-12 and trace ids in trace_ids.txt.
- Access limited to two named Redwood engineers (Mateo and one additional on-call), plus ops+triage@cartographylabs.com.
- DocuSign attestation required before support access is granted.
- Audit logs must be captured and retained for 90 days for this access event.
- Engineering to confirm deletion and email ops+triage@cartographylabs.com + CS when complete.

Mateo — please open SUP-4123, attach the attestation, provision the temporary retention, and DM me the ticket when done. I'll mark this as escalated-followup so CS can track the customer comms.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
